# Bugday

Bugday is an ecommerce marketplace for shoppers in Turkmenistan. Customers can browse products by category, search the catalog, compare product details, and order with local delivery.

## Important pages
- Home: /
- Catalog: /category
- Search: /search
- Become a seller: /become-seller
- Pickup points: /pickup-points

Product and category URLs are discoverable through /sitemap.xml. Account and checkout pages are private customer flows and should not be indexed.
